posts.title: Welcome to the board
posts.body: You do not know what someone is going through today. A simple 'I hope you're having a good day' can really make someone's day.

posts.title: Local food pantries always need hands
posts.body: Food pantries and banks are a great place to start if you're not sure where to volunteer — flexible hours, real impact, right in your community.

posts.title: Developing a positive mindset
posts.body: This is a great video on how to develop a positive mindset which is important for the helath of you, your family, and your friends.

We went as a family and had a great time. It was so nice getting to meet the people who work hard to keep our community safe, and there were fun activities that got the kids out of the house and into the community for the day. This year's event was collecting school supplies, so it was a great chance to give back while having fun together. Grateful for events like this — more, please!
posts.title: Fill the Squad.  A great day for the whole family

posts.body: The Karl Junginger Memorial Library looking for volunteers for their Wiener and Kraut Day book sale as well as baked goods to be donated for the bake sale.   If interested, please use the link provided by the Karl Junginger Memorial Library

posts.body: Keep your head up and keep moving forward. Life throws curveballs, but you will get through it.  One step, one day at a time.  You got this!
